story.head: Evangelista sparks a Devils comeback
paras: Anthony Duclair got the scoring started for the Islanders late in the first, but Evan Rodrigues tied it 1-1 for New Jersey just 17 seconds later. Matthew Schaefer put the Islanders back ahead 2-1 just under two minutes later. Declan Chisholm made it 2-2 for New Jersey early in the second, and Simon Holmström restored the Islanders’ lead 26 seconds later. Victor Eklund made it 4-2 midway through the period. Luke Evangelista cut the Isles’ lead to 4-3 early in the third, and Dougie Hamilton tied it 4-4 on the power play with a little over six minutes left. Jack Hughes won it a little over a minute into overtime.
The Devils carried the play, outshooting the Islanders 50-23, but needed overtime to win it. Jake Allen made 19 saves for the Devils, and Ilya Sorokin stopped 45 of 50 at the other end.

A scrum late in the second sent four players to the box. Duclair and Brayden Schenn picked up ten-minute misconducts. The Devils improved to 12-5-0, second in the Metropolitan, while the Islanders dropped to 7-6-3, fifth in the Metropolitan.

items.text: Four straight wins for the Devils.
The Islanders are winless in three (0-2-1).
Anthony Duclair scored again against New Jersey, and has six goals in seven games against them since 2023-24.
Ben Hutton made his Islanders debut, after five seasons with the Golden Knights.
